panel.language.title: Server language
panel.language.label: Language
panel.language.auto: Automatic (the language set in Discord for this server)
panel.language.help: Applies to the texts already translated: slash command descriptions, the player and its controls. Texts not translated yet still show in Portuguese. Automatic follows the language set in Discord; without a complete translation it uses English.
panel.language.unknown: Choose a language from the list.
panel.request_channel.strict.title: Strict jukebox
panel.request_channel.strict.label: Delete right away any message that is not a request or a command
panel.request_channel.strict.help: Applies only to the request channel. A typed song name still counts as a request and is deleted too. Off, the channel stays as it is today.
